data.name: 🛠️ Limitless – Unlimited or Multiply Buy Limits
data.teaser: No more running out of ammo or gear due to stock restrictions — unless you want to keep a higher limit. It’s all configurable.
data.description:
Customize or completely remove both global and personal purchase limits from every trader’s assortment.

💾 Installation

  1. Download the ZIP.
  2. Extract the spt folder.
  3. Start the server — done.

⚙️ Configuration

user/mods/Limitless/config.json:

{
  "PersonalLimits": {
    "Unlimited": true,
    "Multiplier": 5
  },
  "GlobalLimits": {
    "Unlimited": true,
    "Multiplier": 5
  }
}
  • PersonalLimits — how many of an item one character can buy before a trader’s stock resets.
  • GlobalLimits — the shared stock available to all characters. Never touches an item’s price.

Each section has two settings:

  • Unlimited — true removes that limit entirely.
  • Multiplier — only used when Unlimited is false. Scales the original value: 1 leaves it unchanged, 5 makes it 5× larger, and so on.

✅ Default: both limits are fully removed (Unlimited: true on both).

🖥️ Edit it live from the Server Information Center

Limitless registers with SPT 4.1’s Server Information Center → Configs page, so you can flip these toggles and change the multiplier from your browser while the server is running — no file editing, no restart.

🧾 Example Logs

On load:

[Limitless] Applied to 5525 item(s) (personalLimits: unlimited, globalLimits: unlimited)

🔧 Compatibility

Rewritten from the ground up in C# for SPT 4.1.1. SPT’s server moved from Node.js/TypeScript to .NET in the 4.x line, so old JS-based mods (including earlier Limitless releases) can’t load on it — this is a full rewrite, not a patch. If you’re still on SPT 3.11.x, grab the older 0.1.1 release instead.

Let me know if you need help or have suggestions.

Enjoy limitless buying! 💰

versions.description:
Full rewrite for SPT 4.1.1. SPT's server moved from Node.js/TypeScript to C#/.NET in the 4.x line, so old JS-based mods (including earlier Limitless releases) can't load on it anymore — this is a ground-up rewrite, not a patch.

## What's new
- Rewritten in C# against the SPT 4.1.1 server API
- Fixed a bug in the original where "global limits" mutated `barter_scheme` (an item's price) instead of the item's actual stock fields — global limits no longer affect price
- Config simplified to `PersonalLimits` / `GlobalLimits`, each with `Unlimited` (bool) and `Multiplier` (only used when `Unlimited` is false; `1` = no change)
- Registers with SPT 4.1's Server Information Center "Configs" page, so settings can be viewed and edited live from the browser without restarting the server

## Installation
Extract the zip at the root of your SPT install — files land in `SPT_Runtime/user/mods/Limitless/`.

If you're still on SPT 3.11.x, use the `3.11-0.1.1` release instead.
I've tested everything i can test. Everything should work like it needs too. Leave a comment if it doesn't.
